title: Bakery Rush
objective: Tap cakes to bake and earn coins, buy upgrades, complete timed Rush Orders, and unlock larger bakery shops.
controls: Tap the cake in the center to bake and earn coins; tap upgrade cards at the bottom to purchase them; tap floating Golden Cupcakes for a 3x frenzy.
core_loop: Tap the cake to earn coins -> buy tap and auto-baking upgrades -> earn faster to unlock new bakery shops and beat Rush Orders.
progression: Accumulating total coins unlocks new bakery shops (Sweet Corner to Bakery Lane at 150 coins, then Cake Palace at 2,500 coins) with multi-tier cakes and higher upgrade targets.
tone: Bright, pastel pink, upbeat, casual arcade
hook_idea: Activating the Golden Frenzy x3 cupcake during a frantic Rush Order right before unlocking Bakery Lane (t=24.4s-29.5s)
